title: Acme web standup

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Morning all. Quick standup for acme/web today.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Alice here. The login redirect fix for issue 42 is ready for review.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Great, I will look at the pull request after this call.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Bob: the release notes still need the new settings screen.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Let us ship the release on Thursday then.

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: Sounds good. That is all from me.

summary: Alice has the **login redirect fix** (acme/web#42) ready for review; the release ships on Thursday once the notes cover the new settings screen.
